title: Illustrating the Coronation of George V
content: TheIllustrated London Newsran this painting of the coronation of George V in 1911.It was entitled: "He stands surrounded by the Officers of Heralds College"The artists had to work fast to complete their drawings for the next day’s paper. “Every artist had a little notebook which he took out of the pocket of his frock coat and made dots in, putting down his top hat to do so.” Read more in the previous post:Covering the Coronation
